entries.test: constructs default clock and id factory and records a valid request
entries.invariant: default options must produce a usable engine
entries.assertion: approvalId starts with appr_; expiresAt-requestedAt=15min; singleUse true

entries.test: persists every optional request field exactly once
denies submit from an actor other than the requesting operator
entries.assertion: not_authorized; status REQUESTED; only approval.requested emitted

entries.test: records an approval reason and reviews only PENDING records
entries.invariant: reject is PENDING-only and reason is recorded
entries.assertion: reject on APPROVED -> invalid_state + unchanged; approve reason -> decisionReason

entries.test: cancels a PENDING approval with the requester identity and one event
entries.invariant: cancel PENDING path executes and emits once

entries.test: lists a tenant without status filter and keeps the result cloned
entries.invariant: list without status and defensive cloning
entries.assertion: tenant isolation; mutating result does not change store

entries.test: rejects consumption of an approval already marked EXPIRED
entries.invariant: legacy consumption fails closed on EXPIRED

entries.test: matches a resource without id and consumes non-single-use with executionRef
entries.invariant: resource without id matches; reusable consumption persists ref
entries.assertion: executionRef set; executionCount increments; persisted ref reused

entries.test: fails closed when the single-use consumption CAS loses
fails closed when the reusable consumption CAS loses
derives the consumption timestamp defensively when the store drops it
entries.invariant: missing executedAt falls back to clock

entries.test: rejects a reservation whose agent diverges from the approved proposal
entries.assertion: proposal_mismatch; no reservation fields; executionCount unchanged

entries.test: reserves without payload using the matching proposal hash
entries.invariant: proposalHash alone can bind a reservation

entries.test: supports reservations for resources without id
fails closed when the reservation CAS loses
fails closed when marking EXECUTING loses the CAS
propagates a non-fencing store failure while fencing generation conflicts
entries.invariant: generic store errors are rethrown, not treated as fencing

entries.test: confirms only reserved or executing approvals
accepts non-confirmed evidence in markUncertain and rejects confirmed evidence
rejects malformed reconciliation evidence before touching state
each: fails closed when reconciliation with effect_confirmed/no_effect loses the CAS
each: fails closed when release/fail/markUncertain loses the CAS
entries.assertion: invalid_state; status RESERVED; no released/failed/uncertain timestamps

entries.test: fails closed when confirmation loses the CAS
sweeps expired reservations using the engine clock when now is omitted
skips reserved records without a persisted expiry instead of guessing
entries.invariant: no expiry means no sweep decision

entries.test: treats a reservation without expiry as alive for markExecuting
entries.invariant: missing expiry is defensive not expired

entries.test: rejects reserve resume for a partial reservation missing durable fields
entries.invariant: resume cannot fabricate a reservation view

entries.test: releases a legacy reservation without token and emits the reduced event
entries.invariant: legacy record without token still sweeps safely

entries.test: marks a legacy reservation UNCERTAIN without token when proof is unknown
reconciles a legacy UNCERTAIN record without token and emits the reduced event
reconciles a legacy UNCERTAIN record to FAILED with absence proof
resumes a legacy reservation without generation as generation zero
does not expire records when the sweep CAS loses
entries.invariant: expireStale honors CAS and retries later
entries.assertion: first sweep 0 + REQUESTED; second sweep 1 + EXPIRED
